test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question: Eena is Jatin's mother. Pratap is Bani's father. Sukrit is the son of Garv. Suyog's only sister is married to Garv. Suyog is the son of Anshum. Eena's husband is the only son of Pratap. Anshum is the wife of Pratap. Bani is Sukrit's mother. How is Pratap related to Jatin?
solution:
Family tree chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/854e449acd75259b0fdb6ee8f851931989fac9f98d9eedc211a9f6a75ae54a7d.png] 

1) Sukrit is the son of Garv.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34fa864338f102432246ca43730d34ecdc2beb53ecd5d7d33530fb990cdcd7d6.png] 

 

2) Suyog's only sister is married to Garv.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa3eaf3eac6ca5fe6d40248c353647571af02945fd3b709297175acbe48b00ed.png] 

 

3) Suyog is the son of Anshum.

4) Anshum is the wife of pratap.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e04c52cf9e395cac743f99a67cc728169a9fdb331274c957e3308f72ed97d09.png] 

 

5) Eena's husband is the only son of Pratap.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72c6daf5a01503dcf261ae6dfe45e170a5ebaf7602b4a36068eaba1036092af0.png] 

 

6) Bani is Sukrit's mother.

7) Eena is Jatin's mother.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62d7efb33de9a79866b80946a8cb4506499c1dd326d56b09c2ac60c5f764918d.png] 

 

 

Clearly, we can see that Pratap is paternal grandfather of Jatin.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Paternal grandfather".**
